plugin.name: Processes
plugin.description: Find running apps and processes, see their CPU and memory use, switch to them or end them. Type “ps ” (with a space), “kill” or “进程” in the main search.
command.subtitle: Process manager
command.processes.title: Processes
command.processes.keywords: process, processes, task manager, cpu, memory, end task, kill
command.hung.title: End Apps Not Responding
command.hung.keywords: not responding, hung, frozen, kill, force quit
command.restartExplorer.title: Restart Windows Explorer
command.restartExplorer.keywords: explorer, restart explorer, taskbar, start menu
pref.prefixes.title: Prefixes
pref.prefixes.description: Words that list processes in the main search. “ps” needs a space after it; with “kill”, Enter ends the task. Leave empty to turn them off.
pref.interval.title: Refresh every
pref.cpuMode.title: CPU use
pref.cpuMode.description: Share of all processors (as in Task Manager), or of one processor (as in top: up to 100% per processor).
pref.groupByApp.title: Group processes by app
pref.showWindows.title: Show Windows processes
pref.defaultSort.title: Sort by
pref.closeTimeout.title: Wait for apps to close (seconds)
pref.closeTimeout.description: End task asks an app to close and waits this long before offering to force it.
pref.redact.title: Hide secrets in command lines
pref.redact.description: Show values of options such as --password or --token as •••.
pref.foregroundQuit.title: Offer to quit the app in front
pref.foregroundQuit.description: “Quit <app>” in the search, and “Force quit” when the app in front is not responding.
sort.name: Name
row.subtitle: {{.name}} · PID {{.pid}}
view.title: Processes

confirm.end.one: The process will be ended at once; unsaved work is lost.
confirm.end.other: {{.Count}} processes will be ended at once; unsaved work is lost.

confirm.endAllHung.one: The app will be ended at once; unsaved work is lost.
confirm.endAllHung.other: {{.Count}} apps will be ended at once; unsaved work is lost.

confirm.restartExplorer: The taskbar, the desktop and File Explorer windows close and start again.
note.svchost: It hosts Windows services, which stop with it.
note.dwm: The screen may flicker or go black while Windows restarts it.
note.ctfmon: Input methods (such as Chinese input) stop working until you sign in again.
note.sihost: The taskbar and notifications may stop working until you sign in again.
note.textinput: The touch keyboard and emoji panel restart.
note.task: It is a background task of golauncher; stop it in Background Tasks instead to keep its status.
note.critical: A critical system process: ending it would crash Windows or sign you out.
note.shell: Windows Explorer runs the taskbar and the desktop: it is restarted rather than ended.
meta.name: Executable
meta.cpuNoteValue: Share of all processors. Task Manager shows processor utility, which counts turbo speeds, so it can differ by a few percent.
toast.stillRunningHint: It may be asking whether to save. Press Ctrl+Shift+X to force it to end.
toast.needsAdminHint: Press Ctrl+Shift+A to end it as administrator.
toast.protected: {{.name}} is protected and cannot be ended
toast.protectedAdmin: {{.name}} is protected by Windows and cannot be ended, even as administrator
toast.commandLineFailed: Could not read the command line of {{.name}}
fg.forceQuitSubtitle: The app in front is not responding
elevate.prompt: golauncher needs administrator rights to end “{{.name}}”.
command.processes.keywords@darwin: process, processes, activity monitor, task manager, cpu, memory, quit, force quit, kill
pref.cpuMode.description@darwin: Share of one processor, as in Activity Monitor (up to 100% per processor), or share of all processors.
toast.stillRunningHint@darwin: It may be asking whether to save. Press ⌘⇧X to force it to quit.
toast.needsAdminHint@darwin: Press ⌘⇧A to end it as an administrator.
toast.protectedAdmin@darwin: {{.name}} is protected by macOS and cannot be ended, even as an administrator
note.critical@darwin: A critical system process: ending it would sign you out or restart macOS.
meta.commandLineDenied@darwin: Cannot be read (a process of another user)
meta.cpuNoteValue@darwin: Share of all processors. Activity Monitor shows the share of one processor; choose that under CPU use in the preferences.
